definitions.floorContactCoverage: Exact union of footprints of boxes directly touching pallet floor (z=0), divided by pallet footprint.
definitions.projectedCoverage: Exact union of all box footprints projected to XY, divided by pallet footprint. Includes overhanging upper boxes.
definitions.columnVoidLiters: Recorded exact empty volume below local highest box tops; not a trapped/accessibility proof.
definitions.caution: These are observations of the preserved finite-search baseline. More filled floor area alone does not guarantee highest final 3D fill.
